card.label: Demo
card.title: memrynote at a glance
card.subtitle: A quick look at the app.

scenes.title: Intro
scenes.text: Meet {brand}. One idea, from inbox to done.

scenes.title: Inbox
scenes.text: Paste a link, drop a thought. Everything lands in the inbox first.

scenes.title: Triage
scenes.text: Triage in a click. The link is filed, and the idea becomes a note.

scenes.title: Notes
scenes.text: Open it, and write freely. Two brackets link it to anything in your vault.

scenes.title: Tasks in notes
scenes.text: And any line becomes a task, right where you wrote it.

scenes.title: Plan your day
scenes.text: It shows up in Today with everything else. Drag it onto your calendar.

scenes.title: Quick capture
scenes.text: Need another one? Type it once. Date, priority, project. Done.

scenes.title: Journal
scenes.text: Every day gets a journal page. Link the idea, and there's the task, right on your calendar.

scenes.title: Canvas
scenes.text: Lay it out on a canvas. Pull in the kickoff notes, the idea, and its task.

scenes.title: Connect
scenes.text: Then draw arrows to connect the pieces.

scenes.title: Graph
scenes.text: And the graph shows how it all fits together.

scenes.title: Sync and privacy
scenes.text: Synced across your devices, and end to end encrypted. Only you can read it.
